Description: Material printed inside the walls to give the part its strength.
th: ไส้ใน

Description: The low-density infill of the part interior, whose density and pattern are configurable.
th: ไส้ในแบบโปร่ง

Description: The line layout used to fill a region — applies to surfaces (top and bottom), to fills such as sparse or internal solid infill, and to ironing.
th: รูปแบบ

Description: Pattern of parallel straight lines — the default fill for most solid regions and supports. Shares its root with the Aligned Rectilinear, Rectilinear grid and Rectilinear Interlaced variants; keep all four consistent.
th: เป็นเส้นตรง

Description: Pattern of nested loops that follow the region outline. One of the center-based patterns, together with Spiral Inset, Archimedean Chords and Octagram Spiral.
th: ศูนย์กลาง

Description: Rectilinear variant whose lines keep the same angle on every layer instead of alternating. Keep the Rectilinear root recognizable across the whole family.
th: จัดแนวเป็นเส้นตรง

Description: Support base pattern of crossed rectilinear lines forming a grid. Distinct from Rectilinear Interlaced — the two are separate dropdown options and must not share a translation.
th: ตารางเป็นเส้นตรง

Description: Support interface pattern whose rectilinear lines alternate direction between layers. Distinct from Rectilinear grid — the two must not share a translation.
th: เป็นเส้นตรงอินเทอร์เลซ

Description: Fill ordering that lays every line down in one consistent direction for a uniform surface finish. The mathematical sense, not the everyday "monotonous".
th: โมโนโทนิค

Description: Monotonic variant that keeps each line continuous. Keep the same root as Monotonic.
th: เส้นโมโนโทนิค

Description: Infill pattern of connected back-and-forth lines. Distinct from the Snake print order, which also walks a serpentine path.
th: ซิกแซก

Description: Zig Zag variant that rotates the pattern between layers. Keep the Zag family recognizable together.
th: ข้ามแซก

Description: Zig Zag variant whose layers interlock for added strength. Keep the Zag family recognizable together.
th: ล็อคแซก

Description: Infill and support interface pattern of two crossing sets of lines. The pattern name — not the build plate or preview grid.
th: กริด

Description: Infill pattern of three crossing sets of lines forming triangles.
th: สามเหลี่ยม

Description: Infill pattern combining triangles and hexagons.
th: ไตรหกเหลี่ยม

Description: Infill pattern of stacked cubes standing on a corner. Root of the Adaptive Cubic, Quarter Cubic and Support Cubic variants.
th: คิวบิก

Description: Cubic variant that subdivides towards the part surface, denser near the shell than in the core. Keep the Cubic root.
th: ลูกบาศก์แบบปรับได้

Description: Cubic variant built from quarter-offset cells. Keep the Cubic root.
th: ควอเตอร์ลูกบาศก์

Description: Very sparse Cubic variant meant to hold up top surfaces rather than add strength. Keep the Cubic root.
th: รองรับคิวบิก

Description: Pattern that grows only branching supports under top surfaces and leaves the rest hollow. Used both as a sparse infill and as a support base pattern.
th: ฟ้าผ่า

Description: Infill pattern of hexagonal cells. Root of the 3D Honeycomb and Lateral Honeycomb variants.
th: รังผึ้ง

Description: Honeycomb variant whose cell walls shift with height. Keep the Honeycomb root.
th: รังผึ้ง 3 มิติ

Description: Honeycomb variant oriented sideways for lateral strength. Keep the Honeycomb root.
th: รังผึ้งด้านข้าง

Description: Infill pattern of sideways-oriented lattice cells.
th: ตาข่ายด้านข้าง

Description: Infill pattern whose layers cross at alternating angles.
th: ครอสแฮทช์

Description: Infill based on the Schwarz D (Diamond) triply periodic minimal surface. TPMS is an acronym and Schwarz a proper name; most catalogs keep the label verbatim.
th: TPMS-D

Description: Infill based on the Fischer-Koch S triply periodic minimal surface. TPMS is an acronym and Fischer-Koch a proper name; most catalogs keep the label verbatim.
th: TPMS-FK

Description: Infill pattern based on the gyroid minimal surface. Proper name of the surface.
th: ไจรอยด์

Description: Infill following the Hilbert space-filling curve. Named after the mathematician; keep the proper name.
th: ฮิลเบิร์ต เคิร์ฟ

Description: Center-based pattern following an Archimedean spiral. Named after Archimedes; keep the proper name.
th: คอร์ดอาร์คิมีดีน

Description: Center-based pattern that spirals outward as an eight-pointed star.
th: เกลียวแปดเหลี่ยม

Description: Center-based pattern whose nested loops are joined into one continuous inward spiral. Shares its shape with Concentric; keep the two distinct.
th: เกลียวร่นเข้า

Description: Support base pattern meaning no base pattern at all — the support interior is left empty. The Default for Tree supports.
th: กลวง

Description: The outermost perimeter loop of each layer — the surface the user sees.
th: ผนังด้านนอก

Description: The perimeter loops printed behind the outer wall.
th: ผนังด้านใน

Description: The number of perimeter loops (walls) printed around each layer.
th: จำนวนรอบผนัง

Description: The solid outer skin of the part — its walls plus the top and bottom layers.
th: ผนัง

Description: The upward-facing side of the print — its surfaces, shells and layers (Top surface, Top shell layers). Not the camera “Top view”, and not the text-alignment sense (msgctxt “Alignment”).
th: ด้านบน

Description: The downward-facing side of the print, the one against the build plate — its surfaces, shells and layers (Bottom surface, Bottom shell layers). Not the camera “Bottom view”, and not the text-alignment sense (msgctxt “Alignment”).
th: ด้านล่าง

Description: A rounded transition between two edges or surfaces.
th: ลบมุมมน

Description: A flat, angled (beveled) transition between two edges or surfaces (contrast with a rounded Fillet).
th: ลบมุมเอียง

Description: A flat band of extrusions around the first layer that improves bed adhesion.
th: ขอบยึดชิ้นงาน

Description: Bulging or flaring of the first layers, caused by the weight of the print pressing them out.
A loop printed around the object without touching it, to prime and stabilise the flow.
th: เส้นล้อมชิ้นงาน

Description: A tall wall printed around the model to shield it from drafts and keep chamber heat even.
th: แนวป้องกันลม (Draft Shield)

Description: A printed platform under the object, used instead of printing on the bed directly.
th: ฐานรองชิ้นงาน

Description: Tower printed beside the model to purge the nozzle after each filament change. Two English names for one object — see the note below.
th: Prime Tower / Wipe Tower

Description: Extruding filament to clear the previous material from the nozzle, e.g. at the prime tower on a filament change. Two English names for one action.
th: ไล่เส้น

Description: The prime tower layer where two materials meet and are purged into each other. Distinct from a support interface.
th: เลเยอร์อินเทอร์เฟซ

Description: Calibration model for tuning Pressure Advance.
th: พีเอ ทาวเวอร์

Description: Calibration model that shows ringing/ghosting artifacts, used to tune input shaping.
th: ริงกิ้งทาวเวอร์

Description: Input-shaping calibration model printed at high speed and acceleration.
th: ฟาสท์ ทาวเวอร์

Description: Vertical Fine Artifacts: faint repeating vertical wall marks, targeted by the VFA test. Acronym kept in English.
th: VFA

Description: Unwanted visual defects on the printed surface.
th: สิ่งแปลกปลอม

Description: An extrusion spanning a gap with no material beneath it.
th: สะพาน

Description: Printing a flat span across a gap between two supports, with no material beneath. See Bridge.
th: การพิมพ์สะพาน

Description: A downward-facing surface sloped beyond the angle the printer can print without support.
th: ส่วนยื่น

Description: A hole approximated as a many-sided polygon so it prints closer to round.
th: โพลีโฮล

Description: A second, hot pass over top surfaces that smooths them.
th: รีดผิว

Description: The visible start/end point of each perimeter loop on a layer.
th: รอยตะเข็บ

Description: A seam split into a sloped, overlapping (scarfed) transition to hide it and add strength. The woodworking joint, not the clothing scarf.
th: รอยต่อ Scarf (Scarf joint)

Description: Printed structure that holds up overhangs and is removed after the print.
th: ส่วนรองรับ

Description: Organic, branch-shaped supports that touch the model at fewer points.
th: ส่วนรองรับแบบต้นไม้

Description: Extra extrusions that fill thin spaces the walls are too wide to cover.
th: เติมช่องว่าง

Description: Deliberately roughened outer surface, produced by jittering the wall path.
th: ผิวฟัซซี

Description: Fuzzy skin type: Proper name of the noise function. Smooth, natural-looking variations with coherent structure.
th: เพอร์ลิน

Description: Fuzzy skin type: Cloud-like noise pattern for fuzzy skin.
th: บิลโลว์

Description: Fuzzy skin type: Noise pattern that produces sharp ridges.
th: Multifractal แบบสัน

Description: Fuzzy skin type: Cell-based noise pattern for fuzzy skin, named after the Voronoi diagram.
th: Voronoi

Description: Fuzzy skin type: Wave-like noise pattern for fuzzy skin.
th: ระลอกคลื่น

Description: The replaceable tip the melt is pushed through; its bore sets the extrusion width.
th: หัวฉีด

Description: The heated assembly — heat sink, heat break, heater block, heater cartridge, thermistor — that melts the filament and holds the nozzle. Not the nozzle alone, and not the extruder.
th: ฮอตเอนด์

Description: The motor and gears that push filament into the hotend; in multi-tool printers also a whole toolhead.
th: ชุดดันเส้น

Description: Whether the extruder is Direct Drive or Bowden.
th: ประเภทชุดดันเส้น

Description: Extruder mounted on the toolhead, directly above the hotend.
th: ขับตรง

Description: Extruder mounted on the frame, feeding filament through a PTFE tube to the hotend.
th: โบว์เดน

Description: The molten volume held inside the hotend, used to compute flushing on filament change.
th: ปริมาณหัวฉีด

Description: The heated print surface, i.e. the removable build plate, that the first layer sticks to. Two English names for one object.
th: ฐานพิมพ์

Description: One of the project's plates: each holds its own objects and is sliced and printed separately (Add plate, Slice plate, current plate). Where the language has a separate word, keep it apart from Bed / Build plate.
th: เพลต

Description: The printable space of the printer — the build plate area times the maximum Z height.
th: ปริมาตรการพิมพ์ (Build volume)

Description: The moving assembly that carries the hotend and nozzle (and on some printers the extruder).
th: หัวพิมพ์

Description: The printer's enclosed build volume (the hardware enclosure itself, not its temperature setting).
th: ห้องพิมพ์

Description: The fan that blows air onto freshly extruded plastic to solidify it.
th: พัดลมระบายความร้อนบางส่วน

Description: The fan that vents chamber air out of the enclosure.
th: พัดลมดูดอากาศ

Description: Part-cooling settings that control fan behaviour during printing.
th: การระบายความร้อน

Description: The plastic feedstock on the spool.
th: เส้นพลาสติก

Description: A filament slot made up of several physical filaments, printed as alternating sub-layers so their colors blend.
th: เส้นพลาสติกผสม

Description: A real filament loaded in the printer, as opposed to a mixed filament assembled from several of them.
th: เส้นพลาสติกจริง

Description: Z-direction mode in which a mixed filament's sub-layer ratios shift gradually from one component to another as the print rises.
th: เกรเดียนต์ของเส้นพลาสติกผสม

Description: Bambu Lab low-temperature build plate, for PLA and PVA.
th: จานเย็น

Description: Bambu Lab high-temperature plate for engineering materials such as ABS, PC and PA.
th: แผ่นวิศวกรรม

Description: PEI-coated plate with a textured surface, leaving a matte finish on the bottom layer.
th: แผ่น PEI ที่มีพื้นผิว

Description: Convert the model into layers and toolpaths — i.e. generate the G-code.
th: สไลซ์

Description: A saved, selectable set of settings (print, filament or printer).
th: พรีเซ็ต

Description: Pulling filament back to stop the nozzle oozing during travel moves.
th: การดึงกลับ

Description: Pushing filament forward again to resume extrusion after a retraction; the reverse of retraction.
th: คืนเส้น

Description: A multiplier on extrusion flow used to correct over- or under-extrusion.
th: อัตราส่วนการไหล

Description: The volume of material extruded per unit of time (mm³/s).
th: อัตราการไหล

Description: Nozzle pressure-compensation calibration (the Pressure Advance factor). Keep it distinct from “Flow ratio” (an extrusion multiplier) and “Flow Rate” (volume per unit of time) — English often shortens all three to “flow”, but most languages need three different terms.
th: ไดนามิกการไหล

Description: Extrusion rate measured by volume rather than by distance (mm³/s).
th: ความเร็วปริมาตร

Description: Unwanted material seeping from the nozzle when it should not be extruding.
th: การป้องกันน้ำซึม

Description: The thickness of a single printed layer.
th: ความสูงเลเยอร์

Description: One printed horizontal slice of the model.
th: เลเยอร์

Description: One of the thin slices a layer is split into so the components of a mixed filament can be laid down in sequence.
th: ซับเลเยอร์

Description: The setting that splits layers containing mixed filaments into sub-layers to produce the color-blending effect.
th: ซับเลเยอร์สีผสม

Description: A single extruded strand of material; also the wall/infill width-spacing unit.
th: เส้น

Description: The function of an extrusion — outer wall, inner wall, infill, support, etc. — which sets its speed and parameters.
th: ประเภทการพิมพ์ (Extrusion role)

Description: Shaping a path or surface to follow the outline (contour) of the model.
th: รูปร่าง Z

Description: The instantaneous speed change a machine allows at a corner; Marlin-style motion setting.
A non-printing move between extrusions, with no material laid down.
th: เดินหัวเปล่า

Description: The air temperature inside the printer's enclosure.
th: อุณหภูมิห้องพิมพ์

Description: Mode that prints the object as one continuous single-wall spiral, with no layer seam.
th: แจกันเกลียว

Description: Video assembled from one frame captured per layer.
th: ไทม์แลปส์

Description: An additional placement of one object on the plate, sharing that object’s geometry. Not Clone or Copy, which produce independent objects — “Fill bed with instances” and “Fill bed with copies” are different actions and must not share a translation. Not the running-application sense either — see Instance (application).
th: อินสแตนซ์

Description: A running copy of the application itself (“Allow only one OrcaSlicer instance”, “Failed to launch a new instance.”). A different sense from the object Instance on the plate — where a language uses the copy/duplicate word for the object sense, this one needs its own term.
th: อินสแตนซ์

Description: Duplicating an object into independent objects, each with its own geometry, counted in “Number of copies”. Distinct from Instance, which only adds another placement of the same object.
th: โคลน

Description: Flipping an object, part or SVG across an axis (“Mirror along the X Axis”, “Mirror horizontally”). It transforms the object in place — unlike Clone, nothing new is created. The bare “Mirror” is a short input label in the SVG/emboss tool.
th: กลับด้าน

Description: A built-in basic shape (cube, cylinder, sphere, ...) that can be added to the plate.
th: รูปทรงพื้นฐาน

Description: The code shown on the printer that authorizes a LAN connection to it.
th: รหัสการเข้าถึง

Description: An add-on software component that extends the application (e.g. the network plug-in).
th: ปลั๊กอิน

Description: A UI dialog box. Translate the "dialog box" sense, not the "dialogue"/conversation sense.
th: กล่องโต้ตอบ

Description: The outer boundary line of a shape or selection.
th: เส้นขอบ

Description: A see-through view showing only a model's edges, not solid surfaces.
th: โครงลวด

Description: Navigator-cube face / View-menu item that looks straight down at the plate. Camera sense — not the Top of the printed part.
th: บน

Description: Navigator-cube face / View-menu item that looks up from below. Camera sense — not the Bottom of the printed part.
th: ล่าง

Description: Navigator-cube face / View-menu item that looks at the front of the plate.
th: ด้านหน้า

Description: Navigator-cube face that looks from behind (msgctxt “Camera View”). The direction “behind” — NOT the “go back / return” button, which is “Back” with msgctxt “Navigation”. The View menu calls the same direction “Rear”.
th: ด้านหลัง

Description: Navigator-cube face / View-menu item that looks from the left (msgctxt “Camera View”). Not the left nozzle or text alignment.
th: ซ้าย

Description: Navigator-cube face / View-menu item that looks from the right (msgctxt “Camera View”). Not the right nozzle or text alignment.
th: ขวา

Description: The 100%-dense infill under top surfaces and above bottom ones, as opposed to Sparse infill.
th: ไส้ในแบบทึบ

Description: Wiping the nozzle tip clean / relieving nozzle pressure. Distinct from Flush / Purge, which clears the previous material out of the nozzle channel.
th: เช็ดหัวฉีด

Description: The denser layers between the support and the model surface it touches. Not the prime-tower Interface layer.
th: ผิวสัมผัสส่วนรองรับ

Description: A whole 3D object on the plate. Where a string covers both a model and its parts, prefer the neutral "object".
th: โมเดล

Description: A component of a model. Where a string covers both a model and its parts, prefer the neutral "object".
th: ชิ้นส่วน

Description: A solid body making up a model; a negative volume is a cut-out. Not the numeric volume measurement.
th: ปริมาณ

Description: The image painted onto a surface (custom plate image, model UV map) - not the *textured* rough finish of a plate, fuzzy skin or top surface, which is a different word in most languages.
th: พื้นผิว

Description: An on-canvas manipulation tool (move/scale/rotate handles, cut, paint...).
th: กิสโม่

Description: Bed levelling that probes only the area the print occupies, instead of the whole bed.
th: ตาข่ายฐานพิมพ์ปรับได้

Description: The damping ratio used by input shaping when computing damped oscillations.
th: การทำให้หมาด ๆ

Description: Object-instance print order that walks the plate in a serpentine, row-by-row path (refined with 2-opt). The movement pattern — not the animal, and distinct from the Zig Zag infill pattern.
th: แบบงูเลื้อย

Description: The default object-instance ordering heuristic: each next instance is the closest one not yet visited (“nearest-neighbor chaining”, then refined with 2-opt). It has no standalone msgid — it appears inside the print-order tooltip. Not the “Nearest” seam position, which is a different setting.
th: เพื่อนบ้านที่ใกล้ที่สุด

Description: The main tab for parametric CAD modelling, next to Prepare and Preview; "New Design" starts a new model there.
th: ออกแบบ

Description: A 2D drawing (lines, arcs, circles, splines) made on a plane or a face in the Design tab, which features such as Extrude or Revolve turn into a solid.
th: สเก็ตช์

Description: A geometric or dimensional rule between sketch entities (horizontal, parallel, tangent, coincident, a fixed distance…) that the sketch solver keeps satisfied.
th: เงื่อนไขบังคับ

Description: A driving measurement (length, distance, radius, angle) placed on sketch geometry; editing its value resizes the sketch. Not the object's size ("Dimensions").
th: มิติ

Description: Sketch lines and arcs used only as references for drawing and constraints; they are not part of the profile. Toggled with "Construction".
th: เรขาคณิตช่วยสร้าง

Description: Design-tab feature that pushes a closed sketch profile, or a picked face, along a straight direction to add or remove material. Not the G-code viewer's Extrude move type.
th: ยืดขึ้นรูป

Description: Design-tab feature that spins a sketch profile around an axis to make a solid of revolution.
th: หมุนขึ้นรูป

Description: Design-tab feature that moves a profile along a path sketch to make a solid or a sheet body.
th: กวาดขึ้นรูป

Description: Design-tab feature that skins a smooth shape between two or more profile sketches.
th: ลอฟต์

Description: A solid, or an open sheet, produced by the Design tab's features — the CAD counterpart of an object before it is committed to the plate. Not a model Part or Volume.
th: บอดี้

Description: An open surface body with no thickness and no volume, made by the Surface features; Thicken turns it into a solid.
th: บอดี้พื้นผิว

Description: One step of the Design tab's model history — a sketch, extrude, fillet, plane… — listed in the feature tree and recomputed in order. Not "feature" in the sense of an application capability.
th: ฟีเจอร์

Description: Reference geometry — a plane, axis or coordinate system — created to place sketches and features; it adds no material.
th: เรขาคณิตอ้างอิง

Description: A plane that sketches are drawn on in the Design tab: one of the origin planes (XY, XZ, YZ) or a datum plane added with the Plane feature.
th: ระนาบอ้างอิง

Description: Design-tab datum that sets a local origin and axes on a body; a Mate aligns two of them. Not the World / Object coordinates used by the Prepare tab's transform tools.
th: ระบบพิกัด

Description: An assembly relation that aligns one coordinate system to another (fastened, planar, revolute, slider, cylindrical) to position a body.
th: เมท

Description: A helical screw thread made on a cylindrical surface or in a hole. Not a processing (CPU) thread.
th: เกลียว

Description: Design-tab feature that tilts a face by an angle so it tapers. Unrelated to the Draft shield.
th: มุมถอดแบบ

Description: Design-tab feature that hollows a solid to a wall thickness, opening a picked face. Not the slicer Shell (walls plus top and bottom layers).
th: เปลือก

Description: Design-tab feature that repeats a body in a linear or circular arrangement. Not an infill or surface Pattern.
th: แพทเทิร์น

Description: View that hides the model on one side of a movable cutting plane, to show the inside.
th: มุมมองภาคตัดขวาง

Description: Design-tab command that sends the bodies to the Prepare tab as printable objects, either as one object with a part per body or as one object per body.
th: ส่งไปยังเพลต

Description: The searchable action launcher (Space by default) that runs commands, opens tabs and keeps recent and favourite actions.
th: Speed Dial

Description: A modifier volume added to an object that steers seam placement: the Center, Left and Right subtypes pin the seam to the modifier, while Enforced, Blocked and Neutral mark areas where the seam is preferred, avoided or left to the normal rules.
th: รอยตะเข็บแม่นยำ

Description: Mode that unlocks developer-only settings and tools.
th: โหมดนักพัฒนา

Description: Tool that paints greyscale height-map textures onto a model and bakes them into real surface relief, optionally in colour.
th: การกระจัดพื้นผิว

Description: A greyscale image whose brightness says how far each point of the surface is pushed out.
th: แผนที่ความสูง

Description: Texture-displacement step that turns the painted height maps into real geometry on the model.
th: อบ

Description: Rebuilding a model's triangles to an even density, done before texture displacement is baked.
th: รีเมช

Description: Flattening the painted area into 2D (UV) so a texture maps onto it with as little stretching as possible (LSCM).
th: คลี่ UV

Description: A connected piece of the unwrapped UV surface, edited in the UV editor. Not an island of a print layer.
th: เกาะ UV

Description: A line marked on the model where the UV unwrap is cut open. Not the print Seam (the start and end of a wall loop).
th: เส้นตัด UV

Description: One texture-displacement layer: a texture with its own settings, painted onto the model. Not a print layer.
th: เลเยอร์พื้นผิว

Description: Mesh geometry that cannot bound a closed solid: an open edge, or an edge shared by more than two triangles.
th: non-manifold

Description: The G-code dialect the printer firmware expects (Marlin, Klipper, RepRapFirmware…), chosen in the printer settings. A kind or type, not a taste.
th: ชนิด G-code

Description: A printer whose build surface is a moving conveyor belt under a gantry tilted over it (usually 45°), so a part can be longer than the machine. Not a belt-driven motion system.
th: เครื่องพิมพ์สายพาน

Description: The long, thin object added beside the parts on a belt printer for filament changes to purge into. It replaces the prime tower, which cannot be printed on a belt.
th: หอไล่เส้นบนสายพาน

Description: On a belt printer, the end of a part that reaches the belt first; the leading brim options anchor it to the belt.
th: ขอบนำ

Description: The printer's own coordinate system on a belt printer, into which the sliced coordinates are converted (axis remap, shear and scale). A coordinate frame, not the physical frame of the machine.
th: ระบบพิกัดเครื่อง

Description: The beam that carries one or more carriages across the bed. IDEX/IQEX printers have one or two; on a belt printer it is tilted over the belt.
th: แกนทรี

Description: One independently moving toolhead carrier on a gantry. In parallel printing each active carriage prints one copy of the part.
th: แคร่

Description: IDEX/IQEX printing of several copies of a part at once, one per active carriage, in Copy or Mirror roles; a plate set to it is in a parallel mode.
th: การพิมพ์แบบขนาน

Description: The part of the bed one active carriage prints in during parallel printing; parts are placed in T0's primary zone. Not a resonance or temperature zone.
th: โซน

Description: The role of tool T0, whose toolpaths are sliced while the other carriages follow it, and the normal one-tool-at-a-time mode a plate starts in. The role tiles in the Modes editor use the translated name.
th: หลัก

Description: Carriage role in parallel printing: prints the same part as T0, moving the same way, in its own zone. Not the clipboard Copy. The role tiles in the Modes editor use the translated name.
th: สำเนา

Description: Carriage role in parallel printing: prints a mirror image of T0's part, reflected across the zone boundary. The role (a noun), not the Mirror tool. The role tiles in the Modes editor use the translated name.
th: กระจกเงา

Description: Carriage role on T0's gantry that partners T0 to print a part in several colors while the other gantry copies or mirrors it. A coined role name, kept in English.
th: Span

Description: A function a plugin provides to OrcaSlicer (an importer, exporter, analysis, slicing step…), enabled and configured globally or per preset. Not a printer's hardware capability.
th: ความสามารถ

Description: One of a printer's numbered extrusion tools (T0, T1, …) that a tool change switches between: a toolhead or nozzle. Not a gizmo or other UI tool.
th: เครื่องมือ

Description: On a belt printer, the brim extended ahead of a part along the belt (Leading brim length) to anchor its leading edge.
th: ขอบยึดชิ้นงานด้านนำ

Description: A preset bundle: a package of printer, filament and process presets, installed from a file or subscribed to on OrcaCloud.
th: ชุด

Description: The software running on the printer's controller board (Klipper, Marlin, RepRapFirmware…).
th: เฟิร์มแวร์

Description: The smallest axis-aligned box (or rectangle, in 2D) that encloses an object.
th: กล่องขอบ

Description: The Help menu and the help it gives ("Help > Migrate Filament Presets", "command help"); not the verb in tooltips such as "can help reduce warping".
th: ช่วยเหลือ

Description: A wall loop of the print, inner or outer — a synonym of wall in many labels and tooltips, so Outer wall and Inner wall are the outer and inner perimeters; not only the outer one, and not the Outline of a shape.
th: เส้นรอบวง

Description: A part added to an object, or a height range, that is not printed but changes the settings where it applies ("Add Modifier", "Height Range Modifier", the Precise Seam modifiers); not a printable part or a negative part.
th: ตัวปรับแต่ง

Description: Prime tower layers with no tool change, on which the tower is printed only to keep it growing ("No sparse layers", "Combine sparse layers"); not Sparse infill.
th: เลเยอร์กระจัดกระจาย

Description: A saved copy of presets, a project or a plugin, kept so it can be restored ("Auto backup", "A backup of your presets"); not AMS filament backup, which switches to a spare spool.
th: การสำรองข้อมูล

Description: The removable build sheet as a physical object separate from the heatbed: placed on it, detected, cleaned or flipped (Build Plate Detection, Side A/B, "place it back on the heatbed"). Where a string means the print surface in general, use Bed / Build plate.

A smooth transition from one color to another: color-picker gradients (Gradient start, Gradient end, Linear gradient) and gradient effects. Not the Mixed filament gradient, which is a Z-direction print mode.
th: ไล่ระดับสี

Description: A named collection of preset colors offered in the color picker (Orca Palette, RAL Classic, Palettes).
th: จานสี

Description: Object-manipulation command that spaces the selected objects or parts evenly along an axis. Not Align, which lines them up on a reference.
th: กระจาย

Description: View mode that hides the surrounding interface to concentrate on the 3D canvas.
th: โหมดโฟกัส

Description: A plugin capability type: textures supplied by a plugin from a resource directory inside its plugin folder, offered alongside the built-in texture libraries. The plugin-supplied sense of Texture.
th: พื้นผิวทรัพยากร

Description: The category of a printed line in the G-code preview and statistics (outer wall, infill, support…), called Line Type in the viewer; the statistics export groups its totals by it. Not the Design-tab Feature, and not an application capability.
th: ประเภทเส้น

Description: A region of space (a full-height polygon, or one limited in Z) that the toolhead must not enter; used to exclude models and generated material, check G-code moves and avoid travel. Not the nozzle volume, and not the excluded bed area.
th: ปริมาตรการชน

Description: The part of the bed where models and generated material may not be placed, but where the machine can still travel; a polygon. Not a collision volume.
th: พื้นที่ฐานพิมพ์ที่ยกเว้น

Description: Numbering that starts at 0, so the first item has index 0; used in the G-code variables that report a filament, extruder or nozzle index.
th: เริ่มจากศูนย์

Description: The filament being unloaded and the one being loaded at a filament or tool change; the same pair applies to the extruder or nozzle.
th: กำลังออก / กำลังเข้า

Description: The outline of the wipe tower area that travel moves avoid ("Avoid wipe perimeter"). Not a wall of the part.
th: เส้นรอบวงการเช็ดหัวฉีด

Description: Switching the active printing tool (a toolhead or nozzle) during a print. Not a filament change on a single tool.
th: เปลี่ยนเครื่องมือ

Description: A numbered line of the G-code file, as in "G-code line 120". Not a Line, the extruded strand.
th: บรรทัด

Description: A real extruder of the printer, as opposed to the filament index that some G-code variables (previous_extruder, next_extruder) call an extruder. The extruder counterpart of Physical filament.
th: ชุดดันเส้นจริง

Description: The nozzle's flow class (Standard, High Flow, ...), set per nozzle. The UI labels it Nozzle Flow, and G-code variables also call it a nozzle volume variant. Not the Nozzle volume (the molten volume inside the hotend).
th: ประเภทปริมาณหัวฉีด

Description: How many layers behind a painted top or bottom surface also take the painted color (the Top and Bottom paint penetration layers settings).
th: เลเยอร์การซึมของสี

Description: The path the nozzle follows while extruding, as the Preview draws it and the G-code encodes it. Not a travel move.
th: เส้นทางเครื่องมือ

Description: Moving the axes to their endstops so the printer knows its position (G28). Not parking a toolhead or filament.
th: กลับจุดอ้างอิง

Description: The tool that paints filament colors onto a model's surface, and the painted areas. Not support, seam or fuzzy skin painting.
th: ระบายสี

Description: The application settings dialog and its menu item, not a preset or a print setting.
A spool mounted outside the AMS and fed to the printer directly (Ext spool), not an AMS slot.
The printer's network service (OctoPrint, Moonraker, PrusaLink…) that receives uploaded G-code. Where the English says "printer host" for the printer itself, translate it as the printer.
The rack on toolchanger printers (H2C) that holds spare hotends, not the toolhead.
AMS feature that switches to another spool of the same filament when one runs out, also called AMS filament backup; not a data backup.
Printer connection mode that works only on the local network, without the cloud.
Bambu Lab hardware that routes AMS filament to either extruder (also "filament switcher"), not the generic act of switching filament.
A position in an AMS or filament list that holds one filament, not a slot in the build plate.
Fast extrusion before a filament change that shapes the filament tip for a clean unload (single-extruder multi-material and wipe tower).
The tube above the hot zone where the filament tip is cooled during a single-extruder multi-material change, not the heat break.
Several printheads printing copies of one object side by side (OrangeStorm Giga), distinct from IDEX/IQEX Parallel printing.
The amount of filament purged to clear the previous color on a filament change, as set in the flushing-volume dialog.
A packed file such as a ZIP or SL1 archive, not a backup and not the act of archiving.
A sketch element such as a line, arc or point in the Design tab; not a solid Body.
A plug, dowel or snap the Cut tool adds so the cut parts fit back together.
A mate connector in the Design tab: a coordinate system on a part that a mate attaches to.
How a sketch polygon is sized against its circle: corners on the circle (inscribed) or sides touching it (circumscribed).
The upward- or downward-facing outer surfaces of the print, not the camera views and not the alignment sense.
Firmware vibration compensation that filters motion commands to reduce ringing; the filter itself is the input shaper. Not a calibration of flow or pressure advance.
Marlin's cornering-speed model that replaces classic XY jerk; the setting is its maximum deviation (M205 J). Not Jerk.
Replacing runs of short G-code segments with G2/G3 arc moves. Not a general curve fit of the model.
Printer check that probes for filament clumped around the nozzle during a print. Not a nozzle clog check.
Opening at the back of a Bambu printer through which purged filament is discharged. Not the prime tower.
Small brim discs placed only at sharp corners to hold them down, painted or generated by the Brim ears tool. Not the full brim.
The tool that adds raised or engraved text and SVG shapes to a model. Not texture displacement.
Whether objects are printed layer by layer across the plate or one object after another ("By layer", "By object"). Not the filament or wall order.
Modifier volume or paint that forces support where it would not be generated. Pairs with Support blocker.
Modifier volume or paint that prevents support where it would be generated. Pairs with Support enforcer.
The setting that lowers the temperature of inactive extruders on multi-tool printers so they do not ooze; the setting's name, not the oozing itself (see Ooze).

Printer mode in which one extruder and one nozzle print several filaments by unloading and loading them (MMU-style), as opposed to a printer with several extruders. Not a multi-extruder or tool-changer setup.
The printer's air filter and exhaust fan that clean or vent the chamber air (Support air filtration, Activate air filtration). Not the cooling filter, which is a separate accessory.
